emblem.why: cosmic sovereignty is the ultimate magic trick

lines.directed: Man walks up, all proper: good morning! What do you do, then?
Other geezer goes: Mantramahe-whatever. Cosmic sovereignty, innit. Running the whole show.
You know what man says? Right. Would you like a receipt for that?
See, that's the whole thing in one joke. Infinite power, absolute sovereignty, and man still wants the paperwork.
You lot are exactly the same. Anyway.
